key_insight: Entire sig-jump-diffusions make expected signatures computable through linear ODEs, enabling score-based generative modeling of time series and finite-dimensional data.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces generalized score learning for jump diffusions to linear ODE solves and deterministic optimization.
method: Define jump-diffusions whose characteristics are linear combinations of their own signature components.
Compute expected signatures via linear ODEs; polynomial jump-diffusions admit finite-dimensional systems.
Learn scores directly or, for finite-dimensional data, through inverse signature matching.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical computability and embedding results, but provides no datasets, numerical benchmarks, or empirical performance metrics.
watch_item: Beyond the polynomial case, implementation may require truncating infinite-dimensional signature systems and controlling approximation error.
paper_title: Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
